experiments.headline: Latent causal residue
experiments.key_result: Present observational equivalence does not determine whether a hidden difference is inert, erased, or latent.

experiments.headline: Path compression / minimal connector memory
experiments.key_result: A task-specific residue with 13 classes is sufficient, while a cumulative descriptor with the same class count and entropy leaves 0.25 bits of uncertainty.

experiments.headline: Task-dependent memory
experiments.key_result: The coarsest sufficient preregistered memory descriptor changes with the future query family; expanding from the global-only query to the broad query family refines memory from 13 to 15 classes.

experiments.headline: Authorized query memory
experiments.key_result: Restricted roles retain coarser sufficient memory than full capability memory; selected role descriptors have zero excess unauthorized leakage above the correlation floor in the frozen ensemble.
experiments.info: GLOBAL 0.25-bit reduction; INTERFACE 2.375; DOWNSTREAM 0.7971804688852169; ROUTE 0.25

experiments.headline: Revocation and memory downgrade
experiments.key_result: Full-capability memory deterministically downgrades to role-specific memory while preserving authorized answers; a commitment to discarded old state can restore revoked distinctions in the tiny enumerable domain.
experiments.info: permission revoked != memory downgraded != secure erasure; new-state receipt adds no extra information; old-state receipt collapses revoked uncertainty to zero

experiments.headline: Revocation chains / path independence / reauthorization barriers
experiments.key_result: Monotone FULL→P2→H3 downgrade equals direct FULL→H3, but GLOBAL↔ROUTE lateral transitions are not locally reconstructible after forgetting; an intermediate P2 commitment restores route distinctions in the tiny enumerable domain.

experiments.headline: External authority reauthorization / selective handoff
experiments.key_result: Full authority-store memory resolves four frozen local reauthorization barriers, while the released target-role descriptor answers the new query exactly with zero excess leakage.
experiments.info: GLOBAL→ROUTE 0.25; ROUTE→GLOBAL 0.25; INTERFACE→GLOBAL 2.375; DOWNSTREAM→ROUTE 0.5471804688852168 bits

experiments.headline: Split authority / Keyhole parallax reauthorization
experiments.key_result: Neither authority Keyhole alone resolves either frozen grant, while the authorized pair collapses target uncertainty to zero and releases only the target-role residue.

experiments.headline: Quorum topology / coalition-dependent authority
experiments.key_result: Equal-sized coalitions need not have equal reconstruction power; E1+E2 and E2+E3 are sufficient while E1+E3 remains insufficient.
experiments.info: minimal capable coalitions {E1,E2},{E2,E3}; H(H2|E1,E3)=0.6887218755408672 bits

experiments.headline: Authority access structures / minimal coalition lattices
experiments.key_result: All eight coalitions are enumerated per task; full reconstruction tasks have minimal coalitions {E1,E2} and {E2,E3} with mandatory core E2, while the coarse C-class alarm has minimal singleton coalitions E1 or E3 and no mandatory core.
experiments.info: A_Q={C:H(Q|Dlocal,C)=0}; policy is an upward-closed strict subfamily of capability

experiments.headline: Keyhole criticality / failure sets / policy resilience
experiments.key_result: Full-task capability has minimal cuts {E2} and {E1,E3}; stricter policies introduce additional singleton failure points and lower toy reliability.
experiments.info: Rcap_full=1-p-p^2+p^3; Rpolicy_full=1-2p+p^2; alarm capability has no singleton cut but policy introduces E3

experiments.headline: Policy hardening / redundancy synthesis
experiments.key_result: Every frozen policy removes policy-induced singleton cuts by authorizing exactly one additional coalition; the alarm hardens from 0.900 to 0.981 reliability at p=0.1 while keeping singleton E1 explicitly denied.
experiments.info: full tasks recover capability resilience; alarm adds {E1,E2}, remains a strict capability subset, and has no singleton cut

experiments.headline: Costed policy synthesis / Pareto frontiers
experiments.key_result: Legal governance policies form explicit nondominated cost-fragility-reliability frontiers; hard denies remove points from the feasible set rather than merely raising their cost.
experiments.info: alarm soft frontier=(0,1,0.900),(1,0,0.981),(5,0,0.990); hard deny removes the 0.990 point

experiments.headline: Robust Pareto frontiers / failure-rate uncertainty
experiments.key_result: AH22 frontier membership remains unchanged across six frozen common-failure scenarios when policies are compared by worst-case reliability and maximum regret.
experiments.info: common p in {0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.25,0.30}; alarm soft frontier worst-case values 0.700,0.847,0.910; no membership reversal

experiments.headline: Heterogeneous and correlated failure regimes
experiments.key_result: P12/P23 frontier membership reverses when the fragile outer Keyhole moves; matched one-Keyhole marginals hide a 0.12996 common-cause penalty to dual-path redundancy gain.

experiments.headline: Failure-domain discovery / redundancy auditing
experiments.key_result: Matched marginal failure dashboards conceal radically different joint failure domains; joint traces recover AH24's 0.84816 independent versus 0.71820 common-cause redundancy split.
experiments.info: p1=p3=0.24 for three large controls; statuses independence-compatible, common-mode evidence, other-direction dependence; small sample refuses

experiments.headline: Sequential failure auditing / evidence persistence
experiments.key_result: Raw statistical evidence changes immediately, while a two-hit persistence rule delays governance escalation and clearing by one confirming batch.
experiments.info: raw: insufficient→compatible→common→common→compatible→compatible; governed: no alert→pending→active→pending clear→cleared

experiments.headline: Windowed evidence / horizon-indexed memory
experiments.key_result: The same lifetime aggregate can hide different recent-hazard states; recent-window and discounted evidence preserve order/regime distinctions erased by lifetime accumulation.

experiments.headline: Horizon authorization / evidence least privilege
experiments.key_result: Role-scoped horizon releases preserve residual uncertainty for unauthorized targets, but a role denied Q_MULTI can reconstruct it exactly when authorized for all three component horizons.
experiments.info: H(M|AUDITOR)=0.39355535745192405 bits; H(M|TRI)=0; interface denial != informational non-derivability

experiments.headline: Derivation closure / authority-safe release synthesis
experiments.key_result: TRI direct authority excludes Q_MULTI but its derivation closure includes it; preserving lifetime+recent makes withholding Q_ADAPTIVE the unique minimum repair that turns the deny derivation-safe.

experiments.headline: Collusion closure / coalition effective authority
experiments.key_result: All singleton roles are derivation-safe, but pooled releases create two minimal Q_MULTI-deriving coalitions; exhaustive release removal finds 0 coverage-preserving configurations safe against unrestricted grand-coalition pooling.

experiments.key_result: Nested task requirements produce a monotone frozen utility/privacy frontier: COMMON_ONLY leaves 1.160964 bits residual, TRIAGE leaves 0.4, while FULL_STATUS leaves zero and admits no coalition-safe task-sufficient release design.

experiments.key_result: Across 243 mixed task profiles, 106 retain positive privacy and 137 exactly reconstruct Q_MULTI; specific distinction combinations create abrupt privacy collapse while some task upgrades are free.

experiments.key_result: Across 243 prerequisite-closed distinction-upgrade sets, 137 exactly reconstruct Q_MULTI; the dangerous family has 10 minimal paths and 12 minimal cuts, with a unique two-atom cut blocking all collapse paths.

experiments.key_result: Revocation restores the prospective authority view before it changes already-materialized disclosure; explicit downgrade restores current-view privacy to 0.4 bits while an append-only historical ledger remains exactly reconstructive.

experiments.headline: Hiding commitments / key scope / disclosure-safe epoch receipts
experiments.key_result: Public digest, public salt, and tiny enumerable HMAC/salt secret spaces all expose the frozen old target; a mediated panel-independent VERIFIED receipt preserves the fresh Epoch-1 observer's 0.4-bit residual privacy.

experiments.headline: Delayed key disclosure / authenticator history
experiments.key_result: Key disclosure alone does not recreate an authenticator that never crossed the boundary; releasing the withheld panel-dependent tag into key-bearing history collapses the frozen target, while public toy tags were already declassified before key release.

experiments.headline: Split verification authority / threshold declassification
experiments.key_result: A 2-of-3 coalition may verify Epoch 0 while only 3-of-3 may publicly declassify it; mediated VERIFY_ONLY output preserves 0.4 bits even for the full coalition, whereas explicit declassification or a public old authenticator collapses privacy to zero.

experiments.headline: Verifier compromise / role fusion / quorum resilience
experiments.key_result: Logical quorum thresholds overstate independent physical control when verifier seats are fused: verification falls from two principals to one, strict declassification from three to two, and a weak 2-of-3 declassification control falls to one.

experiments.headline: Independence certification / hidden common control
experiments.key_result: Only complete distinct root-control evidence certifies three independent domains; observed A/B sharing lowers actual VERIFY/DECLASSIFY root thresholds from 2→1 and 3→2, while incomplete evidence refuses the independence claim.
experiments.info: 4 scenarios; CERTIFIED_INDEPENDENT / SHARED_CONTROL_OBSERVED / INDEPENDENCE_UNVERIFIED; p=0.1 reliability independent .972/.729 vs shared .900/.810; hidden shared control is never falsely certified

experiments.headline: Independence evidence decay / revalidation / certificate expiry
experiments.key_result: TTL=2 expires stale independence claims; hidden A/B control can still change inside the fresh window, producing exactly one policy-fresh false-advertisement epoch before expiry; revalidation then discovers shared control.
